body:
I've encountered an issue with `hitsPerPage`.

Here's my code:
```jsx
<Configure hitsPerPage={5} />
```

TypeScript gives me the following error:
```
Type '{ hitsPerPage: number; }' is not assignable to type 'IntrinsicAttributes & PlainSearchParameters'.
Property 'hitsPerPage' does not exist on type 'IntrinsicAttributes & PlainSearchParameters'.ts(2322)
```

Installed packages:
- `"react-instantsearch": "^7.11.2"`
- `"algoliasearch": "^4.23.3"`

Any help on resolving this issue would be greatly appreciated!
